cards.expectation: When it enters, you must sacrifice a creature. A suitable nontoken creature, including the Centaur, can supply the death if it reaches the graveyard.

cards.expectation: Sacrifice a creature to scry 1. You can activate again while the source, suitable creatures and legal timing are available.
cards.diagnosis: The live check examines the creature paid as an activation cost.
cards.oracleText: Sacrifice a creature: Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)

cards.expectation: Pay black mana and sacrifice a creature to destroy target nonblack creature. You must have a legal target to activate.
cards.diagnosis: The sacrifice cost and the separate destruction check answer different questions.
cards.oracleText: {B}, Sacrifice a creature: Destroy target nonblack creature.

cards.expectation: Pay red mana, tap and sacrifice an artifact or land to draw. A nontoken artifact creature inherently satisfies the artifact choice.
cards.diagnosis: The current query recognizes the artifact route and leaves land overlap unresolved. Primary inclusion for type-dependent sacrifice remains a Product Studio decision.
cards.oracleText: {1}{R}, {T}, Sacrifice an artifact or land: Draw a card.

cards.expectation: Pay mana and sacrifice a land to give target creature +2/+0. A land that is also a nontoken creature could supply the death.
cards.diagnosis: The mechanical query leaves land and creature overlap unresolved. The sacrifice policy admits the cost form. No Judith-eligible land-creature partner or animation setup is established here.
cards.oracleText: {1}{B}, Sacrifice a land: Target creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

cards.expectation: Draw when another nontoken creature you control dies. This rewards a death that has already happened.
cards.diagnosis: The authored draw is present. The death walker skips draw and the objective has no general payoff branch. The separate morph diagnostic concerns another ability.
cards.oracleText:

cards.oracleText: When this creature dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

cards.expectation: Create a Treasure when another creature you control dies. The trigger can also observe a token creature.

cards.oracleText: {1}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
